title: Understanding change through reflection

captions.emotions: Feeling the overall picture remain fluid

meaning: Your shared view can understand change more deeply when updating an explanation leaves room for independent reflection.
text: A fluid picture can become more understandable through quiet personal reflection. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating explanations alongside circumstances. The Hermit in energy supports wanting substantial understanding through an independent path. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels the shared image’s changeability. Its first appearance concerns the action of revising a view; its second concerns experiencing the picture’s movement. You may find a new condition’s effect interesting. Your view gains depth when each can consider the connection and make a conclusion understandable to the other.

For example, you examine a city garden in spring and in an autumn photograph. Its earlier description as open space now needs clarification. **A changing picture can be understood through independent reflection.** You update your view, noticing foliage’s effect on apparent distances. Returning to the photographs makes different areas seem central in turn. The garden’s feeling still moves between two states. Personal reflection nevertheless lets each name a particular change affecting impression while preserving a recognisable space and sharing discovered connections.

The risk is continually postponing a shared conclusion because feeling remains fluid, waiting for a finally stable picture. Reflection loses accessibility to each other. Wanting substantial understanding distinguishes changing impressions from clear connections: conditions can already be named while the overall image still shifts whenever you return.
